text: Calling about my granddaughter Ellie, she's 11. Temperature was 39.6 about twenty minutes ago. I'm not one to panic but she isn't quite herself. I've said her name three or four times and she only half opens her eyes, then she's gone again. Usually you can't shut her up. I think her lips look a bit dusky, and her arms and legs have gone sort of mottled, like marble. It might just be the bedside lamp, I'm not sure. There's been no shaking or twitching or anything like that, she's been quite still. Her mum is on nights so it's just me here.
